gaps.explanation: No business-type schedule exists; the Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Fund Net Position - Proprietary Funds (printed p21) prints enterprise columns 'Electric Fund' and 'Water Fund' on trimmed p8 and 'Sewer Fund' and 'Nursing Home Fund' (plus Total) on trimmed p9. JSON receipts = total operating revenues 375,137 + interest income 25,752. Electric: Lease revenues 100,559 + Interest income 1,146 = 101,705. Water: Sales 158,460 + Other revenue 311 + Interest income 12,627 = 171,398. Sewer: Sales 109,807 + Interest income 8,032 = 117,839. Nursing Home: Lease revenues 6,000 + Interest income 3,947 = 9,947. 0 + 101,705 + 171,398 + 117,839 + 9,947 = 400,889 = statement total. No transfers are printed this year.
